data.title: Health insurer rejects insoles request
data.summary: Muster BKK wrote on 14 April 2025 that it will not cover the cost of the sensorimotor insoles you requested on 2 April 2025. It will pay for two pairs of conventional insoles, minus the statutory co-payment.
data.explanation: Your health insurer has partly rejected your request. It will not pay for sensorimotor insoles, because they are not in the official aids directory (Hilfsmittelverzeichnis) and their benefit is not proven. It will pay for two pairs of conventional insoles, minus the statutory co-payment. You may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing, electronically or in person to the insurer. The app shows the deadline for this. If you disagree, decide whether to object, perhaps with your doctor's support. Advice from a patient advisory service may help.

items.title: Objection to the rejection decision
items.action: If you disagree, file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing, electronically or in person with Muster BKK.
items.consequence: After the deadline the decision becomes final.
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch erhoben werden.

key_facts.quote: vielen Dank für Ihren Antrag vom 02.04.2025 und die Verordnung von Dr. Beispiel.

key_facts.quote: Die Kosten für zwei Paar herkömmliche Einlagen übernehmen wir abzüglich der gesetzlichen Zuzahlung.
